evidence.dominant_driver: Australian OIS-implied probability of a November 25bp RBA hike repriced to approximately 51% from 22% on Tuesday after Hauser's hawkish inflation warning; Goldman Sachs changed its November call from hold to hike. This market repricing is incremental information beyond the already-covered speech.

market_expectations.source: Investing.com syndicated on Yahoo Oct 21 and Guardian independent contemporaneous account
market_expectations.distribution_notes: RateProbability OIS estimate ~51% vs 22% prior day; Guardian cited ~45% vs 30% at another snapshot. Probabilities are dynamic and are not synchronized across sources.

absorption.reason: Original Investing.com story was published approximately 217 minutes before decision, and Hauser's remarks occurred on prior day. FF repost at 08:11Z is not the first dissemination. ASX cash market closed at 05:00Z; post-FF cash reaction impossible; no verified futures candles.

observations.AUS200: Cash market had already closed before FF posting; report of 8,831.30 (+0.16%) close is not an isolated reaction to the FF article. Futures response unavailable.

observations.AU_RATES: OIS-implied probability ~51% (22% Tuesday) is direct rate-path repricing, not independent equity confirmation.
